exposure: in-utero antiretroviral (ARV) drug exposure (pre-conception ART, post-conception ART, maternal ARV prophylaxis (AZT), no ARV exposure)
cohort: The study included 2526 children who are HIV-exposed uninfected (CHEU) enrolled at 6 weeks and followed up till 18 months postpartum.
finding: Fetal exposure to ARV drugs had no demonstrable adverse effects on postnatal growth in HIV-exposed uninfected children, while several non-HIV-related maternal, child, and socio-demographic factors were independently associated with growth.
